verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent works on the same tracked issues humans are assigned to. The docs say it can "gather internal context for your team", and humans can inspect the steps it took in the issue log, which implies the human inherits the conversation and context on a shared record. Background agents also prepare investigations before a human arrives. However, nothing in the pack explicitly describes an escalation flow that hands off a summary and collected details. Missing for 10: a documented agent-to-human escalation/handoff mechanism, an auto-generated handoff summary, explicit structured capture of collected customer details at escalation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration that customers don't have to repeat themselves.
